prompts.prompt: When a Stripe invoice is finalized, create a line item in QuickBooks for every invoice line item using OAuth2 bearer tokens with automatic refresh when the access token expires.
When a HubSpot deal is updated, refresh the Google OAuth access token using the stored refresh token, then write a row to Google Sheets.
When a Linear comment is created, use the Linear GraphQL API with a nested mutation to add two reactions and a sub-comment in a single request.
When a Shopify Admin GraphQL productCreate mutation is called, batch-add media URLs via the productCreateMedia mutation inside the same request using GraphQL variables.
When a Shopify order is paid, deduplicate against prior webhook deliveries by order id + header X-Shopify-Webhook-Id and skip if already seen.
When a Stripe charge.refunded webhook arrives, send an idempotent POST to Mailchimp add-tag using an Idempotency-Key header derived from the charge id.
When a Typeform submission arrives with a file answer, upload the file to S3 using a presigned URL fetched from a /sign endpoint before PUTting the bytes.
When a Zendesk attachment is created, download the file and re-upload it to Confluence as a page attachment using multipart/form-data.
When a Zendesk ticket is updated, open a WebSocket to Pusher Channels and push the status change to a channel named after the ticket id.
When a GitHub pull_request is opened, call OpenAI with a structured output schema requesting title and reviewer suggestions, then post as a PR comment.
When a Slack event arrives, verify the X-Slack-Signature by computing HMAC-SHA256 of (v0:timestamp:body) with the signing secret, then forward to Datadog.
When a GitHub push webhook arrives, verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 header against the shared secret before dispatching to a Jenkins job.
When a Linear issue search runs, use cursor pagination with pageInfo.hasNextPage and nested comments on each node, flattening to a Slack digest message.
When a HubSpot search for recently-updated contacts returns, follow the `after` cursor until exhausted and write each page to a BigQuery table in batches of 100.
When a Zendesk ticket is updated, inspect the ticket priority — if high, page via Opsgenie Create Alert API; if normal, create a Jira issue instead.
When a Mailchimp email bounces, look up the subscriber in HubSpot; if the contact has a deal in Won stage, create a Zendesk high-priority ticket; otherwise unsubscribe them in Mailchimp.
When a GitHub stargazer appears, fetch the user profile and their most-starred repos, respecting GitHub REST rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset).
When an Intercom conversation closes, download its transcript PDF via the Intercom API and attach it to a Linear issue using the attachments endpoint.
When a Jotform SOAP-formatted submission arrives, parse the XML envelope, extract named fields, and POST them to Salesforce via the REST Composite API.
When a Twilio call ends, poll the Call Recording resource every 2s with exponential backoff until status is "completed", then forward the recording URL to Slack.
